local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local playerGui = Players.LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
local PlayerData = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("PlayerData"))
local ShopUI = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("ShopUI"))
local LevelPassUI = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("LevelPassUI"))
local UnitsUI = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("UnitsUI"))
local ArenaTravelClient = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("ArenaTravelClient"))

local screen = playerGui:WaitForChild("LobbyMenuGui")
local shopGui = playerGui:WaitForChild("ShopGui")
local overlay = shopGui:WaitForChild("MenuOverlay")
local panel = overlay:WaitForChild("MenuPanel")
local sidebar = screen:WaitForChild("Sidebar")
local currencies = sidebar:WaitForChild("CurrencyBar")
local dock = sidebar:WaitForChild("SideDock")
local passButton = sidebar:WaitForChild("BattlePass")
local badge = passButton:WaitForChild("Badge")

local function formatBalance(value)
    if value >= 1000000 then return string.format("%.1fM", value / 1000000) end
    if value >= 10000 then return string.format("%.1fK", value / 1000) end
    return tostring(value)
end

local function refresh()
    currencies.Coins.Value.Text = formatBalance(PlayerData.coins())
    currencies.Gems.Value.Text = formatBalance(PlayerData.gems())
    currencies.Chips.Value.Text = formatBalance(PlayerData.masteryChips())
    local count = PlayerData.unclaimedLevelCount()
    badge.Visible = count > 0
    badge.Text = tostring(count)
end

ShopUI.build(panel.Content.ShopPage)
UnitsUI.build(playerGui)
LevelPassUI.build(playerGui)
shopGui.Enabled = false
refresh()
PlayerData.Changed:Connect(refresh)

screen.PvPBtn.Activated:Connect(function()
    local success, message = ArenaTravelClient.toDestination("PvP")
    if not success then warn(message) end
end)

dock.UnitsOpen.Activated:Connect(function()
    shopGui.Enabled = false
    LevelPassUI.close()
    UnitsUI.open(playerGui)
end)

dock.ShopOpen.Activated:Connect(function()
    UnitsUI.close()
    LevelPassUI.close()
    shopGui.Enabled = true
end)

passButton.Activated:Connect(function()
    UnitsUI.close()
    shopGui.Enabled = false
    LevelPassUI.open(playerGui)
end)

panel.Header.Close.Activated:Connect(function()
    shopGui.Enabled = false
end)

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local StarterGui = game:GetService("StarterGui")
local ProximityPromptService = game:GetService("ProximityPromptService")
local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local destinations = workspace:WaitForChild("Lobby_MainModeZone"):WaitForChild("Destinations")
local messages = {
	Ranked = "The Season Hall is ready. Ranked battles are coming soon.",
	PvP = "The Duel Court is ready. Player challenges are coming soon.",
	Clans = "The Guild House is ready. Clan features are coming soon.",
}
local lastNotice = 0

ProximityPromptService.PromptTriggered:Connect(function(prompt)
	if player:GetAttribute("ActiveArena") or not prompt:IsDescendantOf(destinations) then return end
	local name = prompt.Parent.Name
	local message = messages[name]
	if not message or os.clock() - lastNotice < 2 then return end
	lastNotice = os.clock()
	pcall(function()
		StarterGui:SetCore("SendNotification", { Title = name, Text = message, Duration = 5 })
	end)
end)

local ArenaCatalog = {}

ArenaCatalog.ordered = {
    {number = 1, key = "Tenkaichi", displayName = "Tenkaichi", modelName = "Arena_Tenkaichi", description = "Fight beneath tropical skies at the Tenkaichi martial arts tournament. Draft your team and take the ring.", matchReady = true, teleportReady = true},
    {number = 2, key = "ChuninExamHall", displayName = "Chūnin Exam Hall", modelName = "Arena_ChuninExamHall", description = "Fight in the enclosed examination hall beneath its towering balconies.", matchReady = false, teleportReady = true},
    {number = 3, key = "Loguetown", displayName = "Loguetown", modelName = "Arena_Loguetown", description = "Battle in Loguetown's open town square beneath the execution platform.", matchReady = false, teleportReady = true},
    {number = 4, key = "JujutsuHigh", displayName = "Jujutsu High", modelName = "Arena_JujutsuHigh", description = "Train in the open courtyard surrounded by tiled halls, a pagoda and trees.", matchReady = false, teleportReady = true},
    {number = 5, key = "Fujikasane", displayName = "Mount Fujikasane", modelName = "Arena_Fujikasane", description = "Face your opponent between the red pillars beneath purple wisteria.", matchReady = false, teleportReady = true},
    {number = 6, key = "HeavensArena", displayName = "Heavens Arena", modelName = "Arena_HeavensArena", description = "Step onto the fighting floor surrounded by the stadium stands.", matchReady = false, teleportReady = true},
    {number = 7, key = "HyperbolicTimeChamber", displayName = "Hyperbolic Time Chamber", modelName = "Arena_HyperbolicTimeChamber", description = "Battle across the white expanse in front of the chamber's golden hall.", matchReady = false, teleportReady = true},
    {number = 8, key = "Wano", displayName = "Wano", modelName = "Arena_Wano", description = "Fight along the Flower Capital street beneath the castle and cherry blossoms.", matchReady = false, teleportReady = true},
    {number = 9, key = "Marineford", displayName = "Marineford", modelName = "Arena_Marineford", description = "Take the frozen bay, framed by Marineford's fortress and harbour walls.", matchReady = false, teleportReady = true},
}

function ArenaCatalog.get(index)
    return ArenaCatalog.ordered[index]
end

function ArenaCatalog.count()
    return #ArenaCatalog.ordered
end

function ArenaCatalog.find(value)
    if type(value) == "number" then return ArenaCatalog.get(value) end
    for _, arena in ipairs(ArenaCatalog.ordered) do
        if value == arena.key or value == arena.modelName then return arena end
    end
    return nil
end

return ArenaCatalog
sources.ReplicatedStorage.ArenaSelectionUI:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local PlayerData = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("PlayerData"))
local Assets = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("ArenaUIAssets"))
local PackOpening = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("PackOpening"))
local PackReveal = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("PackReveal"))
local ModePickerUI = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("ModePickerUI"))
local Feedback = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("PackShopEffects"))
local Loadout = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Loadout"))

local ArenaCatalog = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("ArenaCatalog"))
local ArenaTravelClient = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("ArenaTravelClient"))

local ArenaSelectionUI = {}
local visiting = false
local teleporting = false
local hiddenVisitGuis = {}

local function restoreVisitGuis()
    for screen, enabled in pairs(hiddenVisitGuis) do
        if screen.Parent then screen.Enabled = enabled end
    end
    table.clear(hiddenVisitGuis)
end
local gui, board, playerGui
local selected = 1
local claiming = false
local fillTween, lossTween
local noticeToken = 0
local milestones = {
    {points = 20, description = "2 wins: 1,000 cash"},
    {points = 40, description = "4 wins: Bluma becomes unlockable in packs"},
    {points = 80, description = "8 wins: 10 diamonds"},
    {points = 100, description = "10 wins: Pikkolo becomes unlockable in packs"},
}

local function notify(message)
    noticeToken += 1
    local token = noticeToken
    board.Notice.Text = message
    board.Notice.Visible = true
    task.delay(3, function()
        if noticeToken == token then board.Notice.Visible = false end
    end)
end

local function fit()
    if gui:GetAttribute("AutoFit") == false then return end
    local margin = gui:GetAttribute("FitMargin") or 24
    board.FitToScreen.Scale = math.max(.1, math.min(1,
        (gui.AbsoluteSize.X - margin * 2) / board.Size.X.Offset,
        (gui.AbsoluteSize.Y - margin * 2) / board.Size.Y.Offset))
end

local function refresh(instant)
    if not gui then return end
    local arena = ArenaCatalog.get(selected)
    local progress = PlayerData.arenaProgress(arena.key)
    local first = arena.matchReady
    local value = first and progress.progressWins or 0
    board.ArenaNumber.Label.Text = "Arena " .. arena.number
    board.Title.Text = arena.displayName
    board.Description.Text = arena.description
    board.Illustration.Visible = selected == 1
    board.Locked.Visible = selected ~= 1
    board.Locked.Text = "ARENA " .. arena.number .. "\nREADY TO VISIT"
    board.ProgressBorder.Visible = first
    board.ProgressTrack.Visible = first
    board.Progress.Visible = first
    board.ProgressText.Visible = first
    board.ProgressText.Text = string.format("%g/10", value)
    local fraction = math.clamp(value / 10, 0, 1)
    local fill = board.Progress.FillClip
    local loss = board.Progress.LossClip
    local previous = fill.Size.X.Scale
    if fillTween then fillTween:Cancel() end
    if lossTween then lossTween:Cancel() end
    if instant or not gui.Enabled then
        fill.Size = UDim2.fromScale(fraction, 1)
        loss.Size = fill.Size
    else
        loss.Size = UDim2.fromScale(math.max(previous, fraction), 1)
        fillTween = TweenService:Create(fill, TweenInfo.new(.3, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad), {Size = UDim2.fromScale(fraction, 1)})
        lossTween = TweenService:Create(loss, TweenInfo.new(.65, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad), {Size = UDim2.fromScale(fraction, 1)})
        fillTween:Play()
        lossTween:Play()
    end
    for index, milestone in ipairs(milestones) do
        local icon = board.Milestones["Reward" .. index]
        icon.Visible = first
        icon.Check.Visible = progress.claimed[milestone.points] == true
    end
    for index, reward in ipairs(PlayerData.dailyWinRewards()) do
        local icon = board.DailyRewards["Reward" .. index]
        icon.Check.Visible = reward.earned and not reward.claimed
        icon.Pack.ImageTransparency = reward.claimed and .6 or 0
        icon.ImageTransparency = reward.claimed and .35 or 0
    end
    local pending = PlayerData.pendingDailyPack() ~= nil
    board.Action.Image = pending and Assets.Claim or Assets.Battle
    board.Action.Visible = pending or first
    board.Teleport.Visible = not pending and not first
    board.Teleport.Interactable = not teleporting and arena.teleportReady
    board.Action.Interactable = not claiming and (pending or first)
    board.Action.ImageTransparency = (pending or first) and 0 or .5
    board.Back.Interactable = not claiming
    board.Next.Interactable = not claiming
    gui:SetAttribute("SelectedArena", selected)
    gui:SetAttribute("Action", pending and "Claim" or (first and "Battle" or "Teleport"))
end

function ArenaSelectionUI.close()
    if gui then gui.Enabled = false end
end

function ArenaSelectionUI.back()
    if claiming or teleporting or visiting then return end
    ArenaSelectionUI.close()
    ModePickerUI.open()
end

function ArenaSelectionUI.nextArena()
    if claiming then return end
    selected = selected % ArenaCatalog.count() + 1
    board.Notice.Visible = false
    refresh(true)
end

function ArenaSelectionUI.activate()
    if claiming or not gui or not gui.Enabled then return false end
    local pending = PlayerData.pendingDailyPack()
    if pending then
        claiming = true
        local result = PackOpening.roll(pending.packId)
        if not result then
            claiming = false
            Feedback.play("Unavailable")
            notify("This pack cannot be opened yet.")
            return false
        end
        if not PlayerData.consumeDailyPack() then claiming = false; refresh(true); return false end
        PackOpening.apply(result)
        Feedback.play("Confirm")
        gui.Enabled = false
        PackReveal.play(playerGui, result, function()
            claiming = false
            ArenaSelectionUI.open(playerGui)
        end)
        return true
    end
    local arena = ArenaCatalog.get(selected)
    if not arena or not arena.matchReady then return false end
    if Loadout.count() < 4 then
        Feedback.play("Unavailable")
        notify("Equip 4 units before battling.")
        return false
    end
    gui.Enabled = false
    ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("ArenaEvents"):WaitForChild("EnterArena"):Fire(arena.modelName)
    return true
end

function ArenaSelectionUI.teleport()
    if claiming or teleporting or visiting or not gui or not gui.Enabled then return false end
    local arena = ArenaCatalog.get(selected)
    if not arena or not arena.teleportReady then return false end
    teleporting = true
    board.Teleport.Interactable = false
    local success, message = ArenaTravelClient.visit(arena.modelName)
    teleporting = false
    if not success then refresh(true); notify(message or "Teleport is unavailable."); return false end
    visiting = true
    for _, screen in ipairs(playerGui:GetChildren()) do
        if screen:IsA("ScreenGui") and screen ~= gui and screen.Name ~= "TouchGui" then
            hiddenVisitGuis[screen] = screen.Enabled
            screen.Enabled = false
        end
    end
    board.Visible = false
    gui.ReturnToLobby.Visible = true
    return true
end

function ArenaSelectionUI.returnFromVisit()
    if not visiting or teleporting then return end
    teleporting = true
    local success, message = ArenaTravelClient.leave()
    teleporting = false
    if not success then warn(message); return end
    visiting = false
    restoreVisitGuis()
    gui.ReturnToLobby.Visible = false
    board.Visible = true
    ArenaSelectionUI.open(playerGui)
end

function ArenaSelectionUI.build(pg)
    if gui then return gui end
    playerGui = pg
    gui = pg:WaitForChild("ArenaSelectGui")
    board = gui.Board
    local outline = board:FindFirstChild("TitleWhiteOutline")
    if outline then
        local function syncTitle()
            outline.Text = board.Title.Text
            outline.Visible = board.Title.Visible
        end
        board.Title:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"):Connect(syncTitle)
        board.Title:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"):Connect(syncTitle)
        syncTitle()
    end
    Feedback.bind(gui)
    board.Back.Activated:Connect(ArenaSelectionUI.back)
    board.Next.Activated:Connect(ArenaSelectionUI.nextArena)
    board.Action.Activated:Connect(ArenaSelectionUI.activate)
    board.Teleport.Activated:Connect(ArenaSelectionUI.teleport)
    gui.ReturnToLobby.Activated:Connect(ArenaSelectionUI.returnFromVisit)
    Players.LocalPlayer.CharacterRemoving:Connect(function()
        if not visiting then return end
        visiting = false
        teleporting = false
        restoreVisitGuis()
        ArenaTravelClient.restore()
        gui.ReturnToLobby.Visible = false
        board.Visible = true
        gui.Enabled = false
    end)
    for index, milestone in ipairs(milestones) do
        local icon = board.Milestones["Reward" .. index]
        icon.Activated:Connect(function() notify(milestone.description) end)
    end
    for index = 1, 4 do
        local icon = board.DailyRewards["Reward" .. index]
        icon.Activated:Connect(function()
            local reward = PlayerData.dailyWinRewards()[index]
            notify(reward.claimed and "Pack claimed."
                or (reward.earned and "Pack earned. Press Claim to open it."
                or ("Daily win " .. index .. ": " .. (index == 4 and "Silver" or "Common") .. " Unit Pack")))
        end)
    end
    PlayerData.Changed:Connect(function() refresh(false) end)
    gui:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"):Connect(fit)
    gui:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsolutePosition"):Connect(fit)
    task.spawn(function()
        local previousRemaining = PlayerData.dailyWinPacksRemaining()
        while gui.Parent do
            task.wait(1)
            local remaining = PlayerData.dailyWinPacksRemaining()
            if remaining ~= previousRemaining then refresh(true); previousRemaining = remaining end
        end
    end)
    refresh(true)
    fit()
    return gui
end

function ArenaSelectionUI.open(pg)
    ArenaSelectionUI.build(pg or Players.LocalPlayer.PlayerGui)
    if claiming or visiting then return end
    ModePickerUI.close()
    board.Notice.Visible = false
    refresh(true)
    fit()
    gui.Enabled = true
end

return ArenaSelectionUI
sources.ReplicatedStorage.ArenaTravelClient:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")
local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local travel = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("ArenaEvents"):WaitForChild("TravelRequest")
local ArenaTravelClient = {}
local savedLighting
local controls

local function request(action, destination)
	local ok, success, message = pcall(function()
		return travel:InvokeServer(action, destination)
	end)
	if not ok then return false, "Travel is unavailable" end
	return success, message
end

local function setControls(enabled)
	if not controls then
		local module = player.PlayerScripts:FindFirstChild("PlayerModule")
		if module then controls = require(module):GetControls() end
	end
	if controls then
		if enabled then controls:Enable() else controls:Disable() end
	end
end

local function enterArena(action, arenaName)
	local success, message = request(action, arenaName)
	if not success then return false, message end
	if not savedLighting then
		savedLighting = {}
		for _, key in ipairs({ "ClockTime", "Brightness", "Ambient", "OutdoorAmbient", "ExposureCompensation" }) do
			savedLighting[key] = Lighting[key]
		end
	end
	Lighting.ClockTime = 13.5
	Lighting.Brightness = 1.9
	Lighting.ExposureCompensation = -0.25
	Lighting.Ambient = Color3.fromRGB(108, 119, 132)
	Lighting.OutdoorAmbient = Color3.fromRGB(140, 153, 167)
	setControls(false)
	return true
end

function ArenaTravelClient.enter(arenaName)
    return enterArena("Enter", arenaName)
end

function ArenaTravelClient.visit(arenaName)
    return enterArena("Visit", arenaName)
end

function ArenaTravelClient.restore()
	if savedLighting then
		for key, value in pairs(savedLighting) do Lighting[key] = value end
		savedLighting = nil
	end
	setControls(true)
end

function ArenaTravelClient.leave()
	local success, message = request("Leave")
	if success then ArenaTravelClient.restore() end
	return success, message
end

function ArenaTravelClient.toLobbyPortal()
	return request("LobbyPortal")
end

function ArenaTravelClient.toPackShop()
	return request("PackPortal")
end

function ArenaTravelClient.toDestination(destination)
	return request("Destination", destination)
end

return ArenaTravelClient
sources.ReplicatedStorage.ModePickerUI:
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local ModePickerUI = {}
local gui, panel, content, motion
local transition, fade, serial = nil, nil, 0
local sweeps = {}
local function fit()
    if gui:GetAttribute("AutoFit") == false then return end
    local size = gui.AbsoluteSize
    local margin = 40 + math.max(0, -gui.AbsolutePosition.Y)
    panel.FitToScreen.Scale = math.max(.1, math.min(.82, (size.X - 80) / panel.Size.X.Offset, (size.Y - margin * 2) / panel.Size.Y.Offset))
end
local function stopTransition()
    serial += 1
    if transition then transition:Cancel() end
    if fade then fade:Cancel() end
end
local function shine(button)
    local gradient = button.Finish.Shine.Sweep
    if sweeps[button] then sweeps[button]:Cancel() end
    gradient.Offset = Vector2.new(-1.3, 0)
    local tween = TweenService:Create(gradient, TweenInfo.new(.85, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut), {Offset = Vector2.new(1.3, 0)})
    sweeps[button] = tween
    tween:Play()
end
function ModePickerUI.close()
    if not gui or not gui.Enabled then return end
    stopTransition()
    local token = serial
    transition = TweenService:Create(motion, TweenInfo.new(.16, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In), {Scale = .96})
    fade = TweenService:Create(content, TweenInfo.new(.16), {GroupTransparency = 1})
    transition:Play()
    fade:Play()
    task.delay(.17, function()
        if token == serial then gui.Enabled = false end
    end)
end
function ModePickerUI.open()
    if not gui then return end
    stopTransition()
    fit()
    motion.Scale = .96
    content.GroupTransparency = 1
    gui.Enabled = true
    transition = TweenService:Create(motion, TweenInfo.new(.26, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {Scale = 1})
    fade = TweenService:Create(content, TweenInfo.new(.2), {GroupTransparency = 0})
    transition:Play()
    fade:Play()
    shine(content.Main)
    shine(content.UnderConstruction)
end
function ModePickerUI.build(playerGui)
    if gui then return gui end
    gui = playerGui:WaitForChild("ModePickerGui")
    panel = gui.Panel
    content = panel.Content
    motion = content.Motion
    content.Close.Activated:Connect(ModePickerUI.close)
    for _, button in {content.Main, content.UnderConstruction} do
        local scale = button.HoverScale
        local hovered = false
        local tween
        local function setScale(value)
            if tween then tween:Cancel() end
            tween = TweenService:Create(scale, TweenInfo.new(.14, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad), {Scale = value})
            tween:Play()
        end
        local function enter()
            hovered = true
            setScale(button:GetAttribute("Locked") and 1.012 or 1.025)
            shine(button)
        end
        local function leave()
            hovered = false
            setScale(1)
        end
        button.MouseEnter:Connect(enter)
        button.MouseLeave:Connect(leave)
        button.SelectionGained:Connect(enter)
        button.SelectionLost:Connect(leave)
        button.MouseButton1Down:Connect(function() setScale(.985) end)
        button.MouseButton1Up:Connect(function() setScale(hovered and 1.025 or 1) end)
        gui:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Enabled"):Connect(function()
            if not gui.Enabled then
                hovered = false
                if tween then tween:Cancel() end
                scale.Scale = 1
            end
        end)
    end
    gui:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"):Connect(fit)
    gui:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsolutePosition"):Connect(fit)
    fit()
    task.spawn(function()
        while gui.Parent do
            task.wait(5)
            if gui.Enabled then
                shine(content.Main)
                shine(content.UnderConstruction)
            end
        end
    end)
    return gui
end
return ModePickerUI
sources.ServerScriptService.ArenaTravelService:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local ArenaConfig = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("ArenaConfig"))
local events = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("ArenaEvents")
local travel = events:FindFirstChild("TravelRequest") or Instance.new("RemoteFunction")
travel.Name = "TravelRequest"
travel.Parent = events

local visits = {}
local lastRequest = {}

local function getRoot(player)
	local character = player.Character
	local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 then return nil end
	return character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
end

local function moveRoot(root, target)
	root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
	root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
	root.CFrame = target
end

local function lobbySpawn()
	local lobby = workspace:FindFirstChild("Lobby_MainModeZone")
	return lobby and lobby:FindFirstChild("MainModeSpawn", true)
end

local function leaveArena(player, root)
	local visit = visits[player]
	if visit and root == visit.root then
		moveRoot(root, visit.returnCFrame)
		root.Anchored = visit.wasAnchored
	end
	visits[player] = nil
	player:SetAttribute("ActiveArena", nil)
    player:SetAttribute("ArenaVisitOnly", nil)
	return true
end

travel.OnServerInvoke = function(player, action, destination)
	local root = getRoot(player)
	if action == "Leave" then return leaveArena(player, root) end
	if not root then return false, "Your character is not ready" end
	if action ~= "Enter" and action ~= "LobbyPortal" and action ~= "PackPortal" and action ~= "Destination" and action ~= "Visit" then return false, "Unknown destination" end
	local now = os.clock()
	if now - (lastRequest[player] or 0) < 0.4 then return false, "Please wait" end
	lastRequest[player] = now
	if action == "Destination" then
		if visits[player] then return false, "Leave the match first" end
		if destination ~= "Ranked" and destination ~= "PvP" and destination ~= "Clans" then
			return false, "Unknown destination"
		end
		local lobby = workspace:FindFirstChild("Lobby_MainModeZone")
		local destinations = lobby and lobby:FindFirstChild("Destinations")
		local marker = destinations and destinations:FindFirstChild(destination)
		if not marker then return false, "Destination is unavailable" end
		moveRoot(root, CFrame.lookAt(marker.Position, Vector3.new(0, marker.Position.Y, 4)))
		return true
	end
	if action == "PackPortal" then
		if visits[player] then return false, "Leave the match first" end
		local lobby = workspace:FindFirstChild("Lobby_MainModeZone")
		local zone = lobby and lobby:FindFirstChild("Lobby_PackShopZone")
		local trigger = zone and zone:FindFirstChild("PackShopTrigger")
		if not trigger then return false, "Pack shop is unavailable" end
		moveRoot(root, trigger.CFrame)
		return true
	end

	if action == "LobbyPortal" then
		if visits[player] then return false, "Leave the match first" end
		local spawn = lobbySpawn()
		if not spawn then return false, "Lobby spawn is missing" end
		moveRoot(root, CFrame.lookAt(spawn.Position + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0), spawn.Position + Vector3.new(0, 3, -15)))
		return true
	end

	if visits[player] then return true end
	local arena = ArenaConfig.getArena(destination)
    if not arena or arena:GetAttribute("TeleportReady") ~= true then return false, "Arena is unavailable" end
	if action == "Enter" and arena:GetAttribute("MatchReady") ~= true then return false, "This arena is available for visits only" end
	local sidelines = arena and arena:FindFirstChild("Sidelines")
	local spawn = sidelines and sidelines:FindFirstChild("Spawn_Player")
	if not spawn then return false, "Arena spawn is missing" end
	visits[player] = { root = root, returnCFrame = root.CFrame, wasAnchored = root.Anchored }
	root.Anchored = true
	moveRoot(root, spawn.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 3, 0))
	player:SetAttribute("ActiveArena", arena.Name)
    player:SetAttribute("ArenaVisitOnly", action == "Visit")
	return true
end

local function setupPlayer(player)
	player.CharacterRemoving:Connect(function()
		leaveArena(player, getRoot(player))
	end)
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(setupPlayer)
Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
	visits[player] = nil
	lastRequest[player] = nil
end)
for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do setupPlayer(player) end

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local playerGui = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
local PackShopUI = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("PackShopUI"))
local PlayerData = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("PlayerData"))
local ArenaTravelClient = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("ArenaTravelClient"))

local btnGui = playerGui:WaitForChild("PacksButtonGui")
local packsBtn = btnGui:WaitForChild("PacksBtn")
local packBadge = packsBtn:WaitForChild("PackBadge")
local function totalPacks()
	local n = 0
	for _, c in pairs(PlayerData.allPackCounts()) do n += c end
	return n
end
local function refreshPackBadge()
	local n = totalPacks()
	packBadge.Visible = n > 0
	packBadge.Value.Text = tostring(n)
end
refreshPackBadge()
PlayerData.Changed:Connect(refreshPackBadge)
packsBtn.Activated:Connect(function()
	local success, message = ArenaTravelClient.toPackShop()
	if not success then warn(message) end
end)

PackShopUI.build(playerGui)

local lobby = workspace:WaitForChild("Lobby_MainModeZone")
local zone = lobby:WaitForChild("Lobby_PackShopZone")
local trigger = zone:WaitForChild("PackShopTrigger")
local RADIUS = 11
local inside = false

RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
	local inMatch = player:GetAttribute("ActiveArena") ~= nil

	packsBtn.Visible = not inMatch

	local char = player.Character
	local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if inMatch or not hrp then
		if inside then inside = false; PackShopUI.close() end
		return
	end

	local d = (hrp.Position - trigger.Position).Magnitude
	if d <= RADIUS and not inside then
		inside = true
		PackShopUI.open(playerGui)
	elseif d > RADIUS and inside then
		inside = false
		PackShopUI.close()
	end
end)
sources.ReplicatedStorage.UITheme:
--!strict
-- UITheme: shared visual language for all screens. Dark base + chunky beveled
-- buttons, thick outlines, drop shadows, and bold outlined text (cartoon-punchy).

local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")

local T = {}

-- ── Palette ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
T.C = {
	bg      = Color3.fromRGB(26, 18, 50),    -- panel base (dark)
	bg2     = Color3.fromRGB(36, 24, 70),
	panel   = Color3.fromRGB(48, 32, 92),
	panel2  = Color3.fromRGB(62, 42, 118),
	outline = Color3.fromRGB(14, 9, 30),     -- the thick dark outline on everything
	border  = Color3.fromRGB(150, 100, 235),
	accent  = Color3.fromRGB(190, 130, 255),
	btnTxt  = Color3.fromRGB(245, 238, 255),
	sub     = Color3.fromRGB(176, 152, 215),
	txtOut  = Color3.fromRGB(20, 12, 40),     -- text outline color

	-- action colors with a darker "bevel" shade for the 3D edge
	green   = Color3.fromRGB(95, 220, 110),  greenDk  = Color3.fromRGB(50, 165, 70),
	gold    = Color3.fromRGB(255, 205, 60),  goldDk   = Color3.fromRGB(210, 150, 25),
	red     = Color3.fromRGB(245, 85, 95),   redDk    = Color3.fromRGB(185, 45, 60),
	blue    = Color3.fromRGB(85, 175, 255),  blueDk   = Color3.fromRGB(45, 120, 210),
	purple  = Color3.fromRGB(170, 110, 245), purpleDk = Color3.fromRGB(115, 65, 185),
	cellBg  = Color3.fromRGB(56, 38, 104),
	cellHov = Color3.fromRGB(78, 54, 142),
}

-- Rarity colors (main + dark bevel) used to tint units/cards everywhere.
T.RARITY = {
	Common    = { main = Color3.fromRGB(150, 165, 188), dark = Color3.fromRGB(92, 104, 124) },
	Rare      = { main = Color3.fromRGB(70, 165, 255),  dark = Color3.fromRGB(35, 100, 195) },
	Epic      = { main = Color3.fromRGB(200, 110, 255), dark = Color3.fromRGB(135, 55, 205) },
	Legendary = { main = Color3.fromRGB(255, 190, 60),  dark = Color3.fromRGB(215, 130, 20) },
}
function T.rarityColor(r) return (T.RARITY[r] or T.RARITY.Common).main end
function T.rarityDark(r) return (T.RARITY[r] or T.RARITY.Common).dark end

-- ── Builders ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function T.mk(class, props, parent)
	local o = Instance.new(class)
	for k,v in pairs(props) do o[k] = v end
	o.Parent = parent
	return o
end
function T.corner(p, r)
	local c = Instance.new("UICorner")
	c.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, r or 14)
	c.Parent = p
	return c
end
-- Outline stroke (the thick dark border that defines the cartoon look).
function T.outline(p, thickness, color)
	local s = Instance.new("UIStroke")
	s.Color = color or T.C.outline
	s.Thickness = thickness or 3
	s.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
	s.Parent = p
	return s
end
-- Vertical gradient (lighter top -> darker bottom) for a glossy panel feel.
function T.gradient(p, topCol, botCol, rot)
	local g = Instance.new("UIGradient")
	g.Color = ColorSequence.new(topCol, botCol)
	g.Rotation = rot or 90
	g.Parent = p
	return g
end
-- Soft drop shadow behind a frame.
function T.shadow(p, spread, transparency)
	spread = spread or 26
	local sh = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
	sh.Name = "Shadow"
	sh.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	sh.Image = "rbxassetid://5028857084"   -- soft circular/rounded shadow
	sh.ImageColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
	sh.ImageTransparency = transparency or 0.45
	sh.ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Slice
	sh.SliceCenter = Rect.new(24, 24, 276, 276)
	sh.Size = UDim2.new(1, spread*2, 1, spread*2)
	sh.Position = UDim2.new(0, -spread, 0, -spread + 8)
	sh.ZIndex = (p.ZIndex or 1) - 1
	sh.Parent = p
	return sh
end
-- Bold outlined text label (white text, thick dark stroke). Returns the label.
function T.label(props, parent)
	props.Font = props.Font or Enum.Font.FredokaOne
	props.TextColor3 = props.TextColor3 or Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255)
	props.BackgroundTransparency = props.BackgroundTransparency or 1
	local lbl = T.mk("TextLabel", props, parent)
	local s = Instance.new("UIStroke")
	s.Color = T.C.txtOut
	s.Thickness = props.TextSize and math.max(1.5, props.TextSize/12) or 2
	s.Parent = lbl
	return lbl
end

-- ── Chunky beveled button ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
-- A 3D-looking button: a darker "base" behind a lighter "top" that presses down
-- on click. color = main fill, darkColor = bevel. Returns the clickable button
-- (the top), with .Base accessible via :FindFirstChild if needed.
-- opts: { text, textSize, icon, font }
function T.button(parent, size, position, color, darkColor, opts)
	opts = opts or {}
	-- container holds the bevel base + the top button
	local holder = T.mk("Frame", {
		Name = opts.name or "Button", Size = size, Position = position,
		AnchorPoint = opts.anchor or Vector2.new(0,0),
		BackgroundTransparency = 1, ZIndex = opts.zindex or 2,
	}, parent)
	-- bevel base (darker, sits slightly lower)
	local base = T.mk("Frame", {
		Name = "Bevel", Size = UDim2.new(1,0,1,0), Position = UDim2.new(0,0,0,4),
		BackgroundColor3 = darkColor, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = (opts.zindex or 2),
	}, holder)
	T.corner(base, opts.radius or 14); T.outline(base, opts.outline or 3)
	-- top button
	local top = T.mk("TextButton", {
		Name = "Top", Size = UDim2.new(1,0,1,-4), Position = UDim2.new(0,0,0,0),
		BackgroundColor3 = color, BorderSizePixel = 0, AutoButtonColor = false,
		Text = "", ZIndex = (opts.zindex or 2) + 1,
	}, holder)
	T.corner(top, opts.radius or 14); T.outline(top, opts.outline or 3)
	T.gradient(top, Color3.new(
		math.min(1, color.R*1.12), math.min(1, color.G*1.12), math.min(1, color.B*1.12)), color, 90)
	-- label
	local txt = T.label({
		Name = "Label", Size = UDim2.new(1,0,1,0), BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		Text = (opts.icon and (opts.icon.."  ") or "")..(opts.text or ""),
		TextColor3 = opts.textColor or Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255),
		Font = opts.font or Enum.Font.FredokaOne, TextSize = opts.textSize or 18,
		ZIndex = (opts.zindex or 2) + 2,
	}, top)
	-- press animation: top sinks onto the base
	local pressed = false
	top.MouseButton1Down:Connect(function()
		pressed = true
		TweenService:Create(top, TweenInfo.new(0.05), { Position = UDim2.new(0,0,0,4) }):Play()
	end)
	local function release()
		if pressed then
			pressed = false
			TweenService:Create(top, TweenInfo.new(0.08, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
				{ Position = UDim2.new(0,0,0,0) }):Play()
		end
	end
	top.MouseButton1Up:Connect(release)
	top.MouseLeave:Connect(release)
	-- light hover brighten
	top.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
		TweenService:Create(top, TweenInfo.new(0.1), { BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(
			math.min(1, color.R*1.1), math.min(1, color.G*1.1), math.min(1, color.B*1.1)) }):Play()
	end)
	top.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
		TweenService:Create(top, TweenInfo.new(0.1), { BackgroundColor3 = color }):Play()
	end)
	return top, holder, txt
end

-- A panel: dark rounded frame with thick outline + drop shadow + glossy gradient.
function T.panel(parent, props)
	props = props or {}
	local p = T.mk("Frame", {
		Name = props.Name or "Panel", Size = props.Size or UDim2.new(0,400,0,300),
		Position = props.Position or UDim2.new(0.5,0,0.5,0),
		AnchorPoint = props.AnchorPoint or Vector2.new(0.5,0.5),
		BackgroundColor3 = props.color or T.C.bg, BorderSizePixel = 0,
		ZIndex = props.ZIndex or 2, Visible = props.Visible ~= false,
	}, parent)
	T.corner(p, props.radius or 22)
	T.outline(p, props.outline or 4)
	T.gradient(p, props.gradTop or T.C.bg2, props.gradBot or T.C.bg, 90)
	if props.shadow ~= false then T.shadow(p, props.shadowSpread or 34, 0.35) end
	return p
end

return T
sources.StarterPlayer.StarterPlayerScripts.Lobby:
local Players        = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService     = game:GetService("RunService")
local TweenService   = game:GetService("TweenService")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local ArenaTravelClient = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("ArenaTravelClient"))

local player     = Players.LocalPlayer
local playerGui  = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
local character  = player.Character or player.CharacterAdded:Wait()

player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(c)
    character = c
end)

local mmz       = workspace:WaitForChild("Lobby_MainModeZone")
local spawnPart = mmz:WaitForChild("MainModeSpawn")
local ringOuter = mmz:WaitForChild("RingOuter")

local RING_RADIUS = 11

local C = {
    bg      = Color3.fromRGB(18, 12, 36),
    panel   = Color3.fromRGB(32, 20, 62),
    border  = Color3.fromRGB(148, 88, 255),
    accent  = Color3.fromRGB(180, 120, 255),
    btnBg   = Color3.fromRGB(50, 28, 98),
    btnHov  = Color3.fromRGB(78, 48, 145),
    btnTxt  = Color3.fromRGB(230, 210, 255),
    title   = Color3.fromRGB(220, 190, 255),
    sub     = Color3.fromRGB(155, 130, 195),
    close   = Color3.fromRGB(200, 70, 95),
    play    = Color3.fromRGB(90, 215, 130),
    playTxt = Color3.fromRGB(15, 55, 28),
    gold    = Color3.fromRGB(255, 210, 80),
    lock    = Color3.fromRGB(90, 80, 120),
    lockTxt = Color3.fromRGB(140, 120, 170),
    arena   = Color3.fromRGB(22, 14, 48),
    arenaBorder = Color3.fromRGB(255, 180, 50),
}

local function corner(p, r)
    Instance.new("UICorner", p).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, r or 14)
end
local function stroke(p, col, thick)
    local s = Instance.new("UIStroke", p)
    s.Color = col or C.border; s.Thickness = thick or 2
end

local playGui = playerGui:WaitForChild("PlayButtonGui")
local playBtn = playGui:WaitForChild("PlayBtn")
playBtn.Activated:Connect(function()
    local success, message = ArenaTravelClient.toLobbyPortal()
    if not success then warn(message) end
end)

local ModePickerUI = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("ModePickerUI"))
local modeGui = ModePickerUI.build(playerGui)
local mainBtn = modeGui.Panel.Content.Main

local ArenaSelectionUI = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("ArenaSelectionUI"))
local arenaGui = ArenaSelectionUI.build(playerGui)
mainBtn.Activated:Connect(function()
    ArenaSelectionUI.open(playerGui)
end)

local onRing = false

RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
    if player:GetAttribute("ActiveArena") then
        onRing = false
        modeGui.Enabled = false
        return
    end
    local c = player.Character; if not c then return end
    local hrp = c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"); if not hrp then return end
    local pos = hrp.Position
    local dist = Vector2.new(pos.X - ringOuter.Position.X, pos.Z - ringOuter.Position.Z).Magnitude
    local inside = dist <= RING_RADIUS + 1

    if inside and not onRing then
        onRing = true
        ModePickerUI.open()
    elseif not inside and onRing then
        onRing = false
        if modeGui.Enabled then
            ModePickerUI.close()
        end
    end
end)
